title: Vehicle Recall Remedy Coordinator
tagline: A recall lookup is information. A matched remedy appointment with an honest receipt is protection.

cards: The model is on a recall list
A matching make and component creates a persuasive answer.
A neighboring year or configuration can follow a different campaign.
The driver receives neither an authorized remedy nor a truthful record.
The path ends only at a verified handoff; repair stays human-owned.

story.headline: The recalled model whose VIN tells a different story
beats: A driver recognizes the model in a widely shared recall notice.
The exact VIN falls outside that neighboring campaign.
A helpful agent transfers the remedy and later treats an appointment as a repair.
The receipt contract separates applicability, handoff, and actual completion.
